name: Car Lease Negotiator Core Tool & Audit Regression Suite
description: Validates dealership lookup around ZIP 94550, padded dealer worksheet auditing, and apples-to-apples offer comparison.

parts.text: List Kia dealerships in the Central Valley within 60 miles of 94550 that I should email first for a Kia EV9.

Top Central Valley Kia dealerships within 60 miles of 94550 include Kia Country of Manteca (~32 miles), Kia of Stockton (~45 miles), and Valley Kia of Modesto (~56 miles). Start Wave 1 outreach with itemized lease worksheet emails requesting pre-incentive MSRP discount, KFA lease cash, and Tier-1 buy-rate MF.

Audit this dealer lease offer on a 2026 Kia EV9 Land AWD: MSRP $71,635, selling price $70,935, rebates $18,400, LoJack add-ons $1,695, doc fee $299, cash down $3,000, $5,495 total due at signing, $689/mo incl 10.25% tax for 36 months / 10,000 miles, residual 52%, quoted MF 0.00310 (buy rate 0.00255).

This Kia EV9 Land quote is heavily padded: weak <1% dealer discount off MSRP, $1,695 in LoJack add-ons, illegal $299 California doc fee above the $85 statutory cap, marked-up Money Factor (0.00310 vs 0.00255 Tier-1 buy rate), and $3,000 risky cash cap reduction. Counter with 7.5% pre-incentive discount, $0 add-ons, $85 doc fee, $0 cash down, and 0.00255 buy-rate MF—and send the included email/SMS counteroffer.
Does Volvo Car Financial Services allow refundable MSDs on a Volvo EX90, how many maximum, and what is the VCFS acquisition fee?

Yes—Volvo Car Financial Services (VCFS) supports up to 10 refundable Multiple Security Deposits (MSDs) on the Volvo EX90, lowering the Money Factor by 0.00005 per MSD (up to -0.00050 / -1.20% APR equivalent) without total-loss risk. The standard VCFS acquisition fee is $995.
